exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
Gestational age at diagnosis (<34 weeks vs. ≥34 weeks)
cohort: Placentae from women who underwent caesarean section for clinical indications at different gestational ages, including early-onset pre-eclampsia, late-onset pre-eclampsia, and normotensive controls
finding: Placental stress signaling pathways were significantly higher in early-onset pre-eclampsia compared to late-onset pre-eclampsia and normotensive controls, suggesting a potential role for placental stress in the pathophysiology of early-onset pre-eclampsia.
